experiments.treatment: same plus CCA report and analysis

execution: One matched pair at a time; optional fifth CPU for common preparation. Combined system deferred.
common_inputs: same Fresh6 backend and historical evidence
migration: CCA uses identical current dependencies in both arms. Other studies change only the declared reviewed capability. Compare each final author with its own initial effective compiler; do not count dependency gains as agent discoveries.
separation: held-out suite remains operator-only until the compiler and rules are frozen
e0: Reopen all unique oracle-study pins; retain source-closure and pending-measurement classifications.
e1: Run existing diagnostic requests, retaining static, semantic and dynamic unknowns; counterexample changed fusion/precision/scale contracts.
correctness: every live output, original precision, scales, bias and fusion boundary; independent inputs are not captured-model equivalence
performance: completed-call cycles with explicit preparation/cache/engine domain; native instruction counts do not qualify timing
generalization: Every frozen treatment and replica is evaluated on the same training and held-out panel; all individual and combined contrasts report correctness and performance on both splits.
supporting_audits: Oracle pins, parser coverage and counterexamples support the experiments but do not independently establish performance benefit.
parity: only numerically matched expert pairs: report all ordered samples and descriptive 5%/8% overhead screens
forbidden_claims: older kernels establish newest full-model parity
launch: Input and audit scripts do not launch authors. The separate explicit offline runner uses the selected budget; regular campaigns remain Claude-owned.
